thread:
maria: Compliance ping 1 - they want a one-click export 'who changed routing policies' but with fine-grained actor consent for tenant downloads. Can we spec this?
jeff: We should not let huge exports tank SLOs. Do we have a separate quota for ad-hoc audits?
sam: Current quotas are per-tenant streaming; propose a dedicated export job quota and a circuit breaker for long-running jobs.
nana: ana: Security flagged PII risk if we return emails or full names. Suggest default to pseudonymized actors plus separate mapping artifact only available to admins.
security-team: Prefer hashed actor id in main export, and an optional mapping file behind KMS-protected access. Also require signed presigned links with limited lifetime.
maria: UX thought 1: in export modal add a checkbox "Include actor details". If checked: require admin 2FA and add to the export quota; if unchecked: show actor hints like "team=payments,role=admin".
jeff: Proposed API: POST /v1/audit/exports body { range, filter, actor_resolution: "none|hashed|alias" } returns 202 { job_id, estimated_events }.
sam: Prefer explicit enum values: none|hashed|alias_to_id. Backend should queue job and return job id immediately.
audit-bot: Export job accepted (job=exp_20260320_01) estimated 120s for 40k events.
nana: ana: Console needs cost/telemetry: estimated token count, estimated runtime, and an alert if runtime > 10m suggesting narrower range or background scheduling.
jeff: Also block UI-triggered exports > 1h unless admin override. We can add a soft limit and an "admin override" flag that requires additional auth.
maria: Important: historical context for rollouts. Exports must include policy_version_id, rollout_anchor, and a patch/diff link so compliance can see "what changed" not just the final state.
security-team: +1 on versioning and require inclusion of authorization proof blob (signed) when change was accepted.
sam: Implementation sketch: stream NDJSON, each line is an event with fields: ts, event_type, actor (hashed or alias), actor_hint, policy_version, diff, auth_proof_ref. Set header X-Actor-Resolution and sign with export signing key. Use S3 presign with KMS for delivery.
jeff: I'll draft the API extension and a console modal mock. @maria can you get compliance to confirm mapping retention policy and whether mapping can be ephemeral?
maria: Filing a compliance request now. Quick sample NDJSON lines: 
{"ts":"2026-03-20T15:00:00Z","event":"route.change","actor":"hash:3f1b9c","actor_hint":"team=payments;role=admin","policy_version":"pv_42","change":"add route X->Y"}
{"ts":"2026-03-20T15:01:00Z","event":"route.canary","actor":"alias:alice","actor_hint":"role=dev","policy_version":"pv_43","change":"canary 10%"}

jeff: Good concrete example. Sync tomorrow 10am to finalize shapes and quota numbers.
